subject.title: fix(agents): reject with AbortError when tool execution is cancelled

question: Should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106422 be the canonical fix for foreground exec cancellation?
rationale: Both branches address the same verified bug with positive real behavior proof, and selecting between overlapping implementations is a maintainer integration choice rather than an automated code repair.

options.title: Land this narrower PR
options.body: Refresh it on current main, run exact-head checks, merge it, and close the competing PR as superseded.

options.title: Prefer the sibling PR
options.body: Use the sibling if its shared abort helper and broader regression coverage are preferred, then close this PR only after that branch is confirmed viable and merged.

recommendation.title: Land this narrower PR
recommendation.body: Refresh it on current main, run exact-head checks, merge it, and close the competing PR as superseded.
